name: Call of Water
label: Quest
description: This quest represents the final gathering trial in a shaman's journey to earn the Call of Water. Directed by the hermit Brine in the southern Barrens…
intro: This quest represents the final gathering trial in a shaman's journey to earn the Call of Water. Directed by the hermit Brine in the southern Barrens, initiates must venture far north into the alien, twilight groves of Ashenvale to collect pure water from the ancient fountain within the Ruins of Stardust.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this waterskin and head deep into the lush forest the night elves call Ashenvale. It is to the far north of the Barrens.

Once you've entered the forest, travel west. Along the mountains that separate Stonetalon and Ashenvale, and beyond Lake Mystral, you will find a holy place: the Ruins of Stardust. At the center of the lake you will find a small fountain.
Bring me a sample of the fountain's water. It will be the final component you'll need before I send you back to Islen.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the water yet, friend? Tales say the ruins were protected by large creatures of nature that do not care for visitors, but those could be myths to scare off the enemies of the night elves.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, friend. With all three samples gathered, I can create for you a vial of the purest water any living creature will find. It will be used in the next steps of your rite of passage.
I am pleased to count you among our kind, friend. You do all adventurer proud, and I look forward to hearing about your exploits in the future.
